verdict.rationale: Apify explicitly supports Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and Crawlee for browser automation, which render JS-heavy SPAs and return fully rendered HTML/data via Actors like the Web Scraper. Community feedback confirms it's used as a headless-browser scraping platform replacing Selenium/PhantomJS setups. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet showing full rendered HTML output extraction example, and no independent benchmark of SPA rendering fidelity.
